description: The Office of Congressman Robert Garcia (CA-42) is currently hiring for a Paid Part-Time Press Intern position (asap - Spring 2025) to work in the Washington, D.C. office. The Press Intern works closely with the communications team.
responsibilities: Drafting press releases and other written materials
Clipping committee remarks and cable hits
qualifications: Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment
how_to_apply: Interested applicants should send a one page resume, 1 sample press release, and 2 relevant sample tweets to sara.guerrero@mail.house.gov and emily.kassnermarks@mail.house.gov with "INTERN APP: Full Name" in the subject line. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
equal_opportunity: The office is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, military status, age, marital status, or parental status.

description: Congressman French Hill (AR-02) seeks interns to serve in his offices in Washington, D.C., and Arkansas. Interns will work in a fast-paced office, gaining valuable exposure and knowledge of the legislative process and the U.S. Congress. Standard internships take place as follows: Spring (January through May), Summer (May through August), Fall (September through November). Internships outside of this schedule may be offered on a case-by-case basis. Paid and unpaid internships are available.
responsibilities: Interacting with Arkansans and other visitors
Assisting Arkansans with matters before the federal government
qualifications: Excellent written and oral communication skills
Working knowledge of current events and policy topics
Willingness to assist with daily office tasks
Social media and other communications experience (a plus)
Ability to listen to and take direction
Willingness to work both independently and as part of a team
how_to_apply: Interested individuals should send a resume and cover letter to ar02.applications@mail.house.gov. For more information, please call (501) 324-5941 or (202) 225-2506 and ask for the Intern Coordinator.
